get.summary: Search the gazetteer: text (q, trigram), category/kind, containment (withinAreaId), curation state (hasCoordinates/source/verified — hasCoordinates=false lists unlocated stubs), and spatial — proximity (nearLat+nearLon[+radiusM], returns distanceM) or viewport (bbox=minLon&bbox=minLat&bbox=maxLon&bbox=maxLat).

post.summary: Create a user place directly (name + optional coordinates/category).

get.summary: Typeahead: trigram-ranked suggestions over places (names + aliases) and AdminArea localities, discriminated by type.
The append-only curation log for a place, oldest first. Readable for tombstoned/merged places; 404 only for unknown ids.
A single place with its aliases, external ids, and containment chain (outermost→innermost). Follows merge redirects.

patch.summary: Curate a place: rename, recategorize, or verify.

post.summary: Re-geocode a place from its address/name and attach coordinates, containment, and OSM id — heals a coordinate-less stub or refreshes a stale fix. A frozen empty geocode answer is always re-asked; force=true also bypasses and overwrites frozen hits. 400 on a no-hit or transient geocoder outage; the place is left unchanged.

Bulk get-by-ids (max 200) — hydrate stored place ids into coordinates in one call. Responses align index-for-index; a null place means unknown or deleted, a merged id returns the survivor. Containment is omitted (use GET /places/{id} for detail).

get.summary: Live places nothing references — cross-checked against contact addresses, calendar items (live + deleted counted separately), and saved places. Fails 400 when a reference source is unreachable (never declares orphans on partial data).

post.summary: Soft-delete orphan places (max 100 per call). References are re-checked per id at prune time; a place referenced since the find returns Referenced and is left alone. Places referenced only by soft-deleted calendar items are never pruned here — use DELETE /places/{id} to override.

get.summary: Text → candidate coordinates + structured address (cached).
The caller's saved places / personal labels (favorites first).

post.summary: Register a device; returns the one-time ingest API key.

delete.summary: Retire a device (revokes its ingest keys).

get.summary: Latest known location per device.
Server-downsampled track (one best-accuracy fix per time bucket).
Materialized stay-points over a time range.
Materialized trips over a time range.

delete.summary: Purge raw fixes + derived docs in a time range (owner erase).

get.summary: List the calendars the caller can access.

Search calendar items (text + tag + parent + attendee contact + category/status filter; recurrence expanded in-window; from/to match occurrences overlapping the window). Text queries and parent/contact filters with no from/to match all-time; otherwise the window defaults to ±1 year. skip/take page over occurrences sorted by start (desc=true for newest first). Only items accepted into a calendar you can read.
Get a single calendar item.
Calendar items anchored to a LupiraGeoApi place (its location, or a travel endpoint). Only items in a calendar you can read.

Places where your events and photos concentrate, derived at read time and ranked by active days (distinct UTC days with an event occurrence or a photo). Events come from calendars you can read (or calendarId), photos are your own. Defaults: all-time up to now, minDays 3, limit 100. A hotspot carries the LupiraGeoApi PlaceId it anchors to, else a reverse-geocoded label.
The caller's resolved local identity (JIT-provisioned on first login). While no contact is linked, one carrying the login email in a readable book is linked.
Search contacts by name: every query word is a name part, or the name text contains the query (case/diacritic-insensitive).

The contact's relationships, identical whichever side stores them: each entry's kind is the other contact's role relative to this one and its label this contact's own name for them. Set includeInferred=true to also return kin derived from the parent/child graph (siblings, grandparents/-children, aunts/uncles, cousins, nieces/nephews), tagged Provenance=Inferred.
Every residency of a contact the caller can read — who lives, holidays and works where.
The door and gate codes at a place. Visible while the caller can read a contact currently living there; otherwise 404.

put.summary: Add or replace a code (the client mints codeId). Needs write on a contact currently living there.

delete.summary: Remove a code. Needs write on a contact currently living there.

get.summary: Geotagged Ready assets in a viewport as GeoJSON: a point per photo when at most 200 are in view or zoom >= 17, else a point per grid cell with its count.

Access.description: A principal's permission on a collection. `Owner` adds member-management + delete rights over `ReadWrite`.

ActionKind.description: A deterministic, no-LLM action executed directly at fire time.

AdminAreaDto.description: A node in the administrative containment tree (Country/Region/Locality).

AdminLevel.description: Level of an AdminArea in the containment tree (Locality → Region → Country).

AvailabilityStatus.description: A presence/availability segment's status. A day may hold several segments (whole-day or timed).

BookingDetail.description:
A reservation/confirmation attached to any category (a booked meal, a ticketed outing, a hotel, a flight).
            `ProviderContactId` reuses a `Contact` (airline, hotel, restaurant, venue); `PartySize` covers a
            table/seat reservation; `Amount`/`Currency` the paid cost.

CalendarEntryStatus.description: Curation state of a CalendarItem within a calendar. `Removed` is retained as a sync tombstone.

excludedOccurrences.description: Recurring items: unmodified starts removed from the series.

extraOccurrences.description: Recurring items: one-off starts added to the series.

occurrenceOverrides.description: Recurring items: occurrences that deviate from the series (null members inherit).

oneOf.description: Event-bound payload (server-side only). At most one of ItemPrompt? CalendarItemDto.Prompt/ItemAction? CalendarItemDto.Action is set.
How well-documented this item is (null = not applicable, e.g. exempt kinds/calendars). Drives Elicit ranking.

createdAt.description:
Server-side timestamps (from the event timeline) + stream version — the ordering/versioning
            surface offline clients key on. `Etag` stays content-derived and is orthogonal.

calendarIds.description: Accepted calendar memberships, limited to calendars the caller can read.

parentItemId.description: Hierarchy link (e.g. the trip a leg belongs to). Title only when the caller can read the parent.

childCount.description: Direct children visible to the caller, independent of the current filters.

oneOf.description: The item's own completeness (same across its occurrences; null = not applicable), so search results rank directly.
Provenance of a read-time-projected occurrence (e.g. Birthdays → a contact). Null for stored items.

CalendarItemOccurrenceDto.description: A single concrete occurrence of an item within a search window (recurrences expanded).

CompletenessGap.description: A field the record is missing or thin on, with its rubric weight (heavier = ask first).

CompletenessScore.description:
How well-documented a record is: `Score` 0..1 (Σ weight·presence / Σ weight), the unmet
            fields ranked by missing mass (weight·absence, largest first), and the rubric version that produced it.
            `null` (not this type) means "not applicable".

ContactAddressType.description: How a contact uses a place: where they live, a vacation home, where they work, or something else.

avatarRef.description: Pointer to an avatar image (URL/media id), never bytes.

emergencyContactIds.description: Ordered designation (first = highest priority) — who to call about this person, not a kinship.

oneOf.description: How well-documented this contact is. Drives contact-enrichment ranking (completeness × relevance).

version.description: Stream version — the offline clients' optimistic-versioning surface (`Etag` stays content-derived).

ContactKind.description:
What the contact card represents. A business/venue (a provider referenced from
            bookings, say) is an `Organization`: no birthday, employer, or kinship applies. `Individual` is ordinal 0
            so pre-existing events replay as persons.

ContactReachChannel.description:
A way to reach a contact — an email address or phone number — with an open string? ContactReachChannel.Type token
            (well-known: home/work/cell/fax/pager/other) and a per-medium bool ContactReachChannel.Preferred flag. A record so event
            payloads stay immutable.

since.description: When the relationship began, if a precise date is known.

ended.description: The relationship ran its course (ex-spouse); it remains for history but asserts no current kinship.

ContactRelationEntryDto.description:
One relationship as seen from the viewed contact, identical whichever side stores it. ContactRelationKind ContactRelationEntryDto.Kind is the OTHER
            contact's role relative to the viewed one and string? ContactRelationEntryDto.Label the viewed contact's own name for them; since, note and the
            ended flag belong to the relationship and read the same from both sides. RelationProvenance ContactRelationEntryDto.Provenance distinguishes stored
            relationships from kin derived off the parent/child graph (returned only when inferred relations are requested).

ContactSocialProfileDto.description:
A contact's social/IM handle as published. Service and handle are guaranteed non-empty —
            `SetProfilesAsync` rejects the write otherwise.

ContainerDto.description:
A calendar the caller can access; `access` is the caller's own grant level.
            `Class`/`Kind` classify the calendar. (Address books live in LupiraContactApi.)

CreatePlaceRequest.description: Create a user place directly (name + optional coordinates/category).

CurationAction.description:
A curation decision recorded on a Place in the append-only `curation_log`. Stable names —
            they are the future event-type names, so never rename a member (add new ones; keep old ones readable).

CurationEventDto.description: One curation-log entry for a place. Readable for tombstoned/merged places too — that is the audit's point.

DeviceKind.description: Kind of registered device that feeds location telemetry.

DisplayNameFormat.description: How a contact's DisplayName renders. Rendering-only — excluded from the content hash. `Full` is ordinal 0 so old events replay to today's behavior.

ExternalScheme.description: External identity system a PlaceExternalId reconciles against.

FallbackMode.description: On a missed contract: retry once then ask (Retry), ask immediately (Ask), or drop (Drop).

FuzzyDate.description:
A date known to year, year-month, or full-day precision — the precision itself carries the certainty
            ("2015" means "sometime in 2015"). Used for residency boundaries.
            int FuzzyDate.Year is always present; int? FuzzyDate.Day requires int? FuzzyDate.Month. Distinct from
            PartialDate, which models the opposite case (year unknown, month-day known).

GapSeverity.description: A field is fully present, weak/partial (0.5), or absent.

osmType.description: OSM identity of the hit (e.g. "way" + 175761024) — the key for `POST /places/from-geocode`.

GeocodeResultDto.description:
A geocoding hit — a coordinate + display label + best-effort structured address and category. Coarse by
            design (coordinates are quantized to the cache grid).

id.description: `place:{placeId}` when anchored, else `cell:{lat},{lon}` of its densest ~100 m cell.

radiusM.description: Distance from the centre to the farthest contributing point.

placeId.description: The LupiraGeoApi place the hotspot anchors to.

label.description: The anchor place's name, else a reverse-geocoded label.

activeDays.description: Distinct UTC days with an event or a photo here.

HotspotDto.description: A place where the caller's events and photos concentrate, derived at read time and ranked by active days.

ItemAction.description: A deterministic payload executed directly (no LLM). `ParamsJson` carries the frozen params (e.g. a SendCheckIn message).

ItemAttendeeDto.description: One attendee's participation, composed from the participation events.

ItemDetails.description:
Composable, category-independent detail for a CalendarItem: any of a reservation (BookingDetail? ItemDetails.Booking),
a movement leg (TravelLeg? ItemDetails.Travel, a `Trip` only), or an availability segment (PresenceDetail? ItemDetails.Presence). Each is
an optional value object rather than a per-kind member, so one event can carry several at once (a booked flight sets both
BookingDetail? ItemDetails.Booking and TravelLeg? ItemDetails.Travel). Location (venue, hotel, clinic) uses the item's `PlaceId`
(a LupiraGeoApi place id) + `LocationLabel`; provider/driver references reuse a `Contact` id.

ItemPrompt.description: An LLM-interpreted, contracted payload → an agent run. Declared at authoring time; enforced by assistant-api at fire time.

fromVisitId.description:
Endpoint visits (when the trip started/ended at a detected stay-point) — lets a client join trips to
            visit markers without time-window heuristics. The trip carries no geometry; fetch the polyline via
            GET /location/track/thinned for [StartTs, EndTs].

LookupPlacesRequest.description:
Bulk get-by-ids (max 200) — hydrates place ids other services store (calendar items, contact addresses)
            into coordinates in one call. Duplicates are allowed; responses align index-for-index with the input.

contactId.description: The caller's own contact ("this card is me"), when linked — the default circles focus.

MeDto.description:
The resolved local identity of the caller: the stable Guid MeDto.PrincipalId plus current
            email/display name — the same identity shape (`principalId`/`email`/`displayName`) the
            platform uses everywhere it returns a person.

OccurrenceOrigin.description:
Ties a projected occurrence back to the entity it was derived from — the birthday occurrence's
            Guid OccurrenceOrigin.SourceId is the contact whose birthday it is.

OriginKind.description: What a read-time-projected occurrence was synthesized from.

OrphanCandidateDto.description:
A live place nothing references: zero contact addresses, zero live calendar items, zero saved places.
            bool OrphanCandidateDto.Prunable is false when soft-deleted calendar items still reference it — an undelete would dangle.

OutputKind.description: The ProposedAction kind a run is contracted to yield (assistant-api validates against it; cal-api only stores it).

PartialDate.description:
A calendar date that may omit the year — a birthday is often known only as a month-day.
            int PartialDate.Month and int PartialDate.Day are always present; int? PartialDate.Year is null when unknown.
            Canonical text is `yyyy-MM-dd` with a year, else `--MM-dd`; other wire formats are the serializers' concern.

ParticipationRole.description: An attendee's role in an item.

thumbUrl.description: The photo's, or a cell's newest photo's.

bounds.description: A cell's photo extent, [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] — where tapping it zooms to.

PhotoMapPropertiesDto.description: One photo when the count is 1, else a grid cell drawn as a count bubble.

PhotoMapResponse.description: GeoJSON-shaped map payload — feeds a MapLibre GeoJSON source directly.

PlaceCategory.description: Semantic type of a place — drives filtering and iconography. Kept vendor-neutral and coarse; extend as needed.

PlaceDto.description:
A gazetteer place. Coordinates are plain lat/lon on the wire; `Containment` is the AdminArea chain
            outermost→innermost. `DistanceM` is populated only on proximity (`near=`) searches.

PlaceEntryDto.description: How to get in at a place: its door and gate codes, shared by everyone living there.

PlaceKind.description:
What a Place is: a point-of-interest (a named venue/entity), a plain street address, or a whole
            settlement/administrative area (city, municipality, region, country) — a centroid, not somewhere you arrive.

PlaceLookupItemDto.description:
`Place` is null when the id is unknown or soft-deleted; on a merge redirect it is the survivor
        (`Place.Id != RequestedId`). Containment is omitted — `GET /places/{id}` remains the detail call.

PlaceSource.description: Provenance of a gazetteer entry: created by a user (may be unverified), derived from geocoding, or imported from a gazetteer.

PlaceSuggestionDto.description:
A typeahead suggestion: a gazetteer place (name/alias trigram match) or an AdminArea locality — cities come
            from the GeoNames seed, so they suggest without anyone having geocoded a POI there. `Context` disambiguates
            (formatted address for places, parent area for localities).

PresenceDetail.description:
A presence/availability segment's status; the span is the item itself (whole-day or timed). Replaces the old
            Availability item kind — presence items live on the availability calendar and are exempt from completeness scoring.

PromptFire.description:
Fire timing (flattened union): OnStart/OnEnd carry nothing; Offset uses `OffsetMinutes` (negative = lead time);
            AllDayAt uses `AllDayAt` (local wall-clock time on the occurrence date).

PromptFireKind.description: When a payload fires relative to its item's occurrence.

PromptIntent.description: What an LLM-interpreted run should accomplish.

PruneStatus.description:
Per-place outcome of an orphan prune: soft-deleted (or already was), skipped because something still
            references it, or the id is unknown/merged.

ReachMedium.description: The medium a reach channel uses. Social/IM handles are modeled separately as ContactSocialProfile.

Ref.description: A reference the fired payload acts on. `Id` for Event/Contact/Task; `Url` for External.

RegisterDeviceRequest.description: Register a device that will feed location telemetry.

RegisterDeviceResponse.description:
Result of registering a device. string RegisterDeviceResponse.ApiKey is the one-time plaintext ingest credential
            (`{keyId:N}.{secret}`) — it is shown only here and never retrievable again; only its hash is stored.

RelationProvenance.description: Whether a resolved relation was stored explicitly or derived from the kinship graph.

ResidencyDto.description: A contact's tie to a geo place over a period. Current = today inside [movedIn, movedOut]; null ends are open.

SavedPlaceDto.description: A caller's saved place / personal label. References a gazetteer place, or carries a raw coordinate.

SuggestionType.description: What a typeahead suggestion points at: a gazetteer SuggestionType.Place or an AdminArea locality.

TrackPointDto.description: A point on a (raw or thinned) track.

TransportMode.description:
Mode of a TravelLeg. Rail split: `Train` = mainline/commuter, `Metro` = rapid transit,
            `Tram` = light/narrow-gauge rail; `Coach` = long-distance bus vs local `Bus`.

TravelLeg.description:
One leg of a `Trip`. Mode-agnostic: `DeparturePoint`/`ArrivalPoint` generalize gate/platform/stop,
            `Carrier` the airline/operator, `ServiceNumber` the flight/train/service number. `ToPlaceId`/`FromPlaceId`
            are LupiraGeoApi place ids with denormalized `ToLabel`/`FromLabel`; `DriverContactId` names the driver
            for a TransportMode.Car leg.

UpdatePlaceRequest.description:
Curate a place: rename, recategorize, reclassify, verify, or correct its location. Omitted members are left
            unchanged. `Latitude`+`Longitude` (both required together) move the point — for fixing a wrong geocode by
            hand; `WithinAreaId` re-anchors containment to match.

Cookie.description: Session cookie minted by the BFF's OIDC login.
Cookie.name: __Host-lupira-maps

Bearer.description: Authentik access token from a native client; audience must include lupira-maps.
